Roller Shade.description: Roller shades give living spaces adaptable comfort — large windows, small openings, multi-functional rooms — with a clean, cutting-edge look. Our fabric programme spans decorative plains, sheers, technical solar screens and total blackouts, in practical widths that avoid joins and seams.

Neolux Shade.description: A contemporary dual-banded shade: alternating sheer and solid bands glide past each other so you decide exactly how much light and privacy you want, from open view to dim-out.

Sliding Panel.description: Designed to cover large glass surfaces and to separate areas in multipurpose spaces. The panel system works with 2 to 5 channels and cord, wand or motor operation, hiding the mechanism for a uniform look with almost no light gap.

Cellular.description: Honeycomb cells trap air for the best insulation of any shade — and stack to almost nothing when raised. From airy sheers to full blackout.

Dune.description: The evolution of traditional draperies: soft, lightweight two-layer fabric with the fluid look of a curtain and the precise control of a blind. Cord, wand or motorised operation.

Horizontal.description: 2-inch wood and wood-effect slats bring distinguished character to any space, with light control by tilt and finishes that pair with any furnishing.
